def tilemap():
    a = current_frame.ascii
    rows = a.split('\n')
    P = [[rows[2*r][2*c] for c in range(32)] for r in range(32)]
    TC = set('bRWg')
    tiles = {}
    for r in range(31):
        for c in range(31):
            if not all(P[r+i][c+j] in TC for i in range(3) for j in range(3)): continue
            above = r>0 and any(P[r-1][c+j] in TC for j in range(3))
            left = c>0 and any(P[r+i][c-1] in TC for i in range(3))
            if not above and not left:
                pat = ''.join(P[r+i][c+j] for i in range(3) for j in range(3))
                tiles[(r,c)] = pat
    return tiles
before = tilemap()
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':6},{'action':'MOUSE','row':4,'col':14}], intent='solve')

after = tilemap()
diff = []
for k in sorted(set(before)|set(after)):
    if before.get(k) != after.get(k):
        diff.append((k, before.get(k), after.get(k)))
print('tile diffs:', diff)
print('step', current_frame.step, 'level', current_frame.level)
